## Workload

Hannah Lowe completed 423 reads during 212 hours of grading activity. This represents an average throughput of 2.0 reads per hour. The workload was recorded for review to provide a clear view of activity over the assessment period and to support consideration of the time required for each read.

## Quality

A sample of 44 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The level of agreement was 59.1. This result provides the basis for further consideration of grading consistency and identifies the checked work for discussion between the grader and reviewer.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. Hannah Lowe’s workload and the quality findings should be considered together when reviewing the grading process and any follow-up requirements.
